title: A machine learning model for the early prediction of Gram-negative bloodstream infection in ICU patients.
summary: Primary BMC article and Research Square V1 report 405 ICU patients, seven ML models, and XGBoost AUC .898 for early GN-BSI prediction from four features. The first preprint carries the same cohort/model result; prediction is retrospective and single-center.
ai_technology: LASSO selects clinical variables and classifiers including XGBoost predict early gram-negative bloodstream infection in ICU patients.
organization: Department of Clinical Laboratory, The First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University, Hefei, Anhui Province, China

evidence.tested: Primary BMC article and Research Square V1 report 405 ICU patients, seven ML models, and XGBoost AUC .898 for early GN-BSI prediction from four features. The first preprint carries the same cohort/model result; prediction is retrospective and single-center.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
